run_create_model_cli: run create_model.main with builder, arch_name, data_shape, and output_dir args to generate JIT models
test_model_zoo_create_model: test the create_model tool by running it with fbnet_c arch and verifying JIT output files
test_custom_arch_json: test the create_model tool with a custom architecture defined as a JSON blocks dictionary
register_custom_block_primitive: register a custom block primitive like CachedPlus into blocks_factory.PRIMITIVES for the fbnet_v2 builder
test_cached_output_module: test a custom torch.nn.Module with cached output attributes using the fbnet_v2_backbone builder
